dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, many people have said that they've seen the Wild Hunt around?

dialogues.speaker: Alena
dialogues.text: ...Well, many people believe they've seen the Wild Hunt. But it's more likely that what they actually saw was some kind of monster.

dialogues.speaker: Alena
dialogues.text: And sometimes, there's another explanation. For merchants like us, it's pretty common to lose or damage some of our goods whenever we travel from place to place.

dialogues.speaker: Alena
dialogues.text: Then, when the client asks about it, some people just reflexively blurt out "the Wild Hunt" as an excuse. But of course, that's never actually true.

dialogues.speaker: Alena
dialogues.text: But occasionally, some of us do run into the Wild Hunt. When that happens, I notify Piramida through our usual channels.
